name: Drutopia Search
description: Ships a ready-made Search API database index, search View, and facets for site content.
project_description:
Content search functionality using Search API and the database backend.

 This is what powers faceted search on Drutopia sites .

 Features 
 Provides common search features using the powerful Search API using the built-in database backend for Drutopia content feature modules:

 
 Drutopia Action 
 Drutopia Article 
 Drutopia Blog 
 Drutopia Campaign 
 Drutopia Event 
 Drutopia Organization 
 Drutopia Page 
 Drutopia People 
 Drutopia Resource 
 
 Post-Installation 
 This module configures what is needed for other feature modules— no need for you to do anything.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Recommended with all of the above Drutopia feature modules! It can also work with your own custom content types. For more power or more scale, the default database search backend can be swapped out for Apache Solr .

 Supporting this Module 
 You can support Drutopia at opencollective.com/drutopia . Thanks!!

 Community Documentation 
 Overall Drutopia documentation is at docs.drutopia.org">
